identity.name: Christian Raphael A. Carandang
identity.headline: Intern Level Designer and 3D Modeler
about: Hello! I'm Christian Raphael A. Carandang, a passionate Computer Science student who enjoys exploring the creative and technical sides of technology. I'm particularly interested in 3D modeling, animation, C# programming, and visual design, where I get to combine creativity with problem-solving to bring ideas to life.

I enjoy working on hands-on projects that allow me to develop my skills, experiment with new technologies, and turn concepts into meaningful digital experiences. I'm always eager to learn, take on new challenges, and collaborate with others who share the same passion for creating innovative and engaging projects.

projects.name: MUTED
projects.description: MUTED is a 3D interactive PC game that allows players to complete six spacecraft repair missions using real-time hand gestures through a webcam. Powered by computer vision and AI-based gesture recognition, the game translates physical hand movements into in-game actions, creating a touchless and immersive gameplay experience. It also integrates CNN and CNN+GRU models to evaluate gesture recognition accuracy, stability, and responsiveness during live gameplay.
